item.title: AWS Lambda now supports a batch size of up to 10,000 messages for Amazon SQS
item.description:
Lambda event source mappings for Amazon SQS now accept larger batches.

Use the larger batch size to cut invocations for high-volume queues. See the documentation for limits.
item.author: aws@amazon.com

item.title: Amazon S3 Vectors raises the filterable metadata limit
item.description: Each vector can now carry more filterable metadata.
item.author: aws@amazon.com

item.title: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless is now available in the Africa (Cape Town) Region
item.description: Starting today the service is available in one more Region.
item.author: aws@amazon.com

item.title: Amazon CloudWatch extends the PromQL query window to 30 days
item.description: Longer windows are available for PromQL queries.

item.title: AWS Sign-In introduces configurable sign-in duration
item.description: Administrators can set how long a console session lasts.
item.author: aws@amazon.com

item.title: Web Search on Amazon Bedrock expands language support
item.description: More languages are supported & country-aware search is added.
